purpose: Anchor ongoing migration from the continuously changing development source into the distributable AI-Bridge product repository.

safe_copy: ordinary Runtime bug fixes whose product path has not diverged
Houdini Adapter kernel fixes whose distributable semantics are unchanged
tests that remain generic and contain no developer-machine state
rebase_required: any file already productized differently in AI-Bridge
do_not_distribute: candidate or project-family knowledge as generic execution authority
delta_policy.knowledge_rule: Never incrementally copy a stale clean Knowledge Pack. Regenerate distributable knowledge from the latest source Knowledge tree using the clean filter after each delta synchronization.
delta_policy.post_sync_rule: After a successful delta sync and validation, advance this baseline to the reconciled source commit and record the old/new baseline in CHANGELOG.md.
